Parasnath Hill Controversy Explained | Jains vs Santhals Conflict Over Parasnath Hill | UPSC
A sacred hill in Jharkhand, known as Parasnath, has become the center of a long-standing friction between Jains and Santhal tribal communities. The hill is a revered Jain pilgrimage site (Shikharji), while the Santhals claim cultural and ancestral rights over the same land for traditional rituals.
Key Points:
The spiritual importance of Parasnath Hill for Jains
The Santhal tribe’s connection to the land and their traditions
Why the hill is a flashpoint of cultural and religious conflict
